entities.summary: Alfredo Stroessner, a notable figure in the history of Paraguay, associated with The Chaco War, Military Politics, and the Stroessner Dictatorship (1954–1989). Preceded by Stroessner seizes power — May 4, 1954 and Chaco War begins — June 1932. Their legacy influenced Itaipú Dam construction begins (with Brazil) and Stroessner overthrown by General Rodríguez — February 3, 1989.
